arxiv-2011-05528.title: Dust Temperature of Compact Star-forming Galaxies at z ∼ 1 − 3 z\sim 1-3 in 3D- HST /CANDELS Journal: ApJ
arxiv-2011-05528.creator: Zuyi Chen, Guanwen Fang, Zesen Lin, Hongxin Zhang, Guangwen Chen, Xu Kong
arxiv-2011-05528.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Zuyi Chen, Guanwen Fang, Zesen Lin, Hongxin Zhang, Guangwen Chen, Xu Kong. Recent simulation studies suggest that the compaction of star-forming galaxies (SFGs) at high redshift might be a critical process, during which the central bulge is being rapidly built, followed by quenching of the star formation.

arxiv-2302-01273.title: Symmetry-reduced low-dimensional representation of large-scale dynamics in the asymptotic suction boundary layer Journal: European Journal of Mechanics -B/Fluids
arxiv-2302-01273.creator: Matthias Engel, Omid Ashtari, Moritz Linkmann
arxiv-2302-01273.description: Abstract An important feature of turbulent boundary layers are persistent large-scale coherent structures in the flow. Here, we use Dynamic Mode Decomposition (DMD), a data-driven technique designed to detect spatio-temporal coherence, to construct optimal low-dimensional representations of such large-scale dynamics in the asymptotic suction boundary layer (ASBL).

arxiv-2302-12923.title: Automatic Classification of Symmetry of Hemithoraces in Canine and Feline Radiographs
arxiv-2302-12923.creator: Peyman Tahghighi, Nicole Norena, Eran Ukwatta, Ryan B Appleby, Amin Komeili
arxiv-2302-12923.description: Abstract Purpose : Thoracic radiographs are commonly used to evaluate patients with confirmed or suspected thoracic pathology. Proper patient positioning is more challenging in canine and feline radiography than in humans due to less patient cooperation and body shape variation. Improper patient positioning during radiograph acquisition has the potential to lead to a misdiagnosis.

arxiv-2310-00459.title: Warps and Breaks in Circumbinary Discs 20XX Warps and Breaks in Circumbinary Discs – References
arxiv-2310-00459.creator: Ian Rabago, Zhaohuan Zhu, Stephen Lubow, Rebecca G. Martin
arxiv-2310-00459.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ian Rabago, Zhaohuan Zhu, Stephen Lubow, Rebecca G. Martin. Disc warping, and possibly disc breaking, has been observed in protoplanetary discs around both single and multiple stars. Large warps can break the disc, producing multiple observational signatures. In this work, we use comparisons of disc timescales to derive updated formulae for disc breaking, with better predictions as to when and where a disc is expected to break and how many breaks could occur.

arxiv-2402-07791.title: Discovering Decision Manifolds to Assure Trusted Autonomous Systems
arxiv-2402-07791.creator: Matthew Litton, Doron Drusinsky, James Bret Michael
arxiv-2402-07791.description: Abstract Developing and fielding complex systems requires proof that they are reliably correct with respect to their design and operating requirements. Especially for autonomous systems which exhibit unanticipated emergent behavior, fully enumerating the range of possible correct and incorrect behaviors is intractable.

arxiv-2408-14542.title: 𝑼 ⁡ ( 𝟏 ) U(1) 𝑹 R -Symmetry Topological Operators from Branes in Holography
arxiv-2408-14542.creator: Thomas Waddleton
arxiv-2408-14542.description: Abstract We study U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) symmetry generators from wrapped branes in Type IIB string theory and M-theory. Specifically, we construct topological defects for the R R -symmetry in 4d 𝒩 = 1 \mathcal{N}=1 and 3d 𝒩 = 2 \mathcal{N}=2 quantum field theories holographically dual to Sasaki-Einstein compactifications.

arxiv-2412-14536.title: Multi-Modal Latent Variables for Cross-individual Primary Visual Cortex Modeling and Analysis
arxiv-2412-14536.creator: Yu Zhu, Bo Lei, Chunfeng Song, Wanli Ouyang, Shan Yu †, Tiejun Huang
arxiv-2412-14536.description: Abstract Elucidating the functional mechanisms of the primary visual cortex (V1) remains a fundamental challenge in systems neuroscience. Current computational models face two critical limitations, namely the challenge of cross-modal integration between partial neural recordings and complex visual stimuli, and the inherent variability in neural characteristics across individuals, including differences in neuron populations and firing patterns.

arxiv-2503-18636.title: Chiral and deconfinement thermal transitions at finite quark spin polarization in lattice QCD simulations
arxiv-2503-18636.creator: V. V. Braguta, M. N. Chernodub, A. A. Roenko
arxiv-2503-18636.description: Abstract We study the effect of finite spin quark density on the chiral and deconfinement thermal crossovers using numerical simulations of lattice QCD with two dynamical light quarks. The finite spin density is introduced by the quark spin potential in the canonical formulation of the spin operator.

We also apply these results to prove a.e. convergence of such T T means.

plos-pone-0002637.creator: Yu-Chih Chen, Han-Shui Hsu, Yi-Wei Chen et al.
plos-pone-0002637.description: PLOS ONE research article. pmc-11358674.title: A potential mechanism of tumor immune escape: Regulation and application of soluble natural killer group 2 member D ligands (Review)
pmc-11358674.creator: Shuhao Huang, Zihao Qin, Feiyang Wang, Yiping Kang, Biqiong Ren
pmc-11358674.description: The immune system is integral to the surveillance and eradication of tumor cells. Interactions between the natural killer group 2 member D (NKG2D) receptor and its ligands (NKG2DLs) are vital for activating NKG2D receptor-positive immune cells, such as natural killer cells.

pmc-11504493.title: Natural Language Processing (NLP) Accurately Identifies LTCF Exposure from Clinical Notes: A Proof-of-Principle Study
pmc-11504493.creator: Katherine Goodman, Philip Resnik, Monica Taneja, Laurence Magder, Mark Sutherland, Scott Sorongon, Eili Klein, Pranita Tamma, Anthony Harris
pmc-11504493.description: Background: Residence or recent stay in a long-term care facility (LTCF) is one of the most important risk factors for multidrug-resistant organism (MDRO) carriage and infection, making reliable identification of LTCF-exposed inpatients a critical priority for infection control day-to-day practice and research.

pmc-11611238.creator: Longsheng Pan, Yongqin Xiong, Yongjie Li, Bomin Sun, Xuemei Li, Shouguo Zhou, Xin Lou
pmc-11611238.description: lutionary method opens new avenues for treating various brain disorders, including essential tremor (ET), Parkinson’s disease (PD), and some psychiatric conditions, without requiring open surgery.[234] However, there is a lack of consensus on standardized protocols, particularly those tailored to Asian demographics.

pmc-12516938.title: Exploring the Rheology and Clinical Potential of Calcium Hydroxylapatite‐Hyaluronic Acid Hybrids
pmc-12516938.creator: Ewelina Kaczuba, Nabil Fakih‐Gomez, Jonathan Kadouch, Rolf Bartsch, Carla Pecora, Yana A Yutskovskaya, Nadine Hagedorn, Radia El‐Banna, Sarah Backfisch, Alec D McCarthy
pmc-12516938.description: BackgroundCombining calcium hydroxylapatite‐carboxymethylcellulose (CaHA‐CMC) with hyaluronic acid (HA) products using Cohesive Polydensified Matrix (CPM) technology leverages the volumizing and hydrating effects of HA and draws upon the regenerative properties of CaHA‐CMC, providing a potentially synergistic approach in aesthetic filling treatments. Despite this potential, the rheological and physical properties of these hybrid fillers remain unreported.

pmc-12519812.title: Discrimination of first-onset patients with bipolar disorder or major depressive disorder using screened biochemical parameters
pmc-12519812.creator: Yuncheng Zhu, Sheng Li, Ju Gao, Fang Wang, Ni Zhou, Chuangxin Wu, Xiaojia Huang, Ningning Li, Xiaohui Wu, Hongmei Liu, Lu Yang, Xiaoyun Guo, Zuowei Wang, Yiru Fang
pmc-12519812.description: BackgroundTheoretical hypotheses suggest differing oxidative stress levels in mood disorders. We evaluated eight oxidative stress-related biochemical markers for further verification in first-onset patients with bipolar disorder (BD) or major depressive disorder (MDD).MethodsWe extracted 224 first-onset patients (BD = 93 and MDD = 131) from the overall sample database of 4647 candidates.

pmc-12592642.title: Association of serum lipid levels, triglyceride–glucose index, systemic immune-inflammation index, and platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio with colorectal cancer: A retrospective study from China
pmc-12592642.creator: Zhiwei Wang, Fanglai Zhu, Lu Dai
pmc-12592642.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectiveThis retrospective case–control study aimed to explore the correlations of blood lipid levels, triglyceride–glucose index, systemic immune-inflammation index, and platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio with colorectal cancer and evaluate their potential value in early risk prediction.MethodsA total of 120 patients admitted to Anqing First People’s Hospital between July 2022 and March 2025 were categorized into a control group (n = 60, normal colonoscopy) and an observation group (n = 60, colorectal cancer).

pmc-12617811.title: Metabolomic insights into the dynamic changes of volatile and non-volatile compounds in Butyriboletus roseoflavus during vacuum drying
pmc-12617811.creator: Ling Song, Shimei Yang, Xiangqian Lv, Ruiping Luo, Yurong Liu, Xing Zhou, Mingying Gui
pmc-12617811.description: The dynamic changes in flavor and quality of Butyriboletus roseoflavus during vacuum drying at 60 °C were systematically characterized using sensory evaluation, colorimetry, targeted free amino acid analysis, and untargeted metabolomics. Fresh mushrooms exhibited bright color with predominant mushroom and earthy aromas, while prolonged drying induced color darkening and shifted aroma toward fatty and roasted notes.

pmc-12965932.title: The psychological burden of diabetes: common mental health disorders, their impact on disease outcomes and strategies for intervention
pmc-12965932.creator: Javed Latoo, Yasser Saeed Khan, Armaan Latoo, Majid Alabdulla, Farida Jan, Nasseer Masoodi, Daljit Sura, Shariful Islam, Ovais Wadoo
pmc-12965932.description: Diabetes mellitus is associated with a high burden of mental health issues, including both formal psychiatric disorders, such as depression and anxiety, and diabetes-specific psychological challenges like diabetes-related distress, psychological insulin resistance, and fear of hypoglycemia. These mental health difficulties significantly impair self-management, treatment adherence, and quality of life, increasing the risk of complications and mortality.

pmc-13010817.title: Multiple, simultaneous abiotic stresses differentially impact downy mildew infection in grapevine
pmc-13010817.creator: Ana Clara Fanton, Michaela Svobodová, Sylvain Prigent, Josep Valls-Fonayet, Éric Gomès, Stéphanie Cluzet, Gregory A Gambetta
pmc-13010817.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Maintaining grapevine health and resilience under climate change demands an understanding of how multiple stresses interact. Climate change has led to more frequent and intense droughts and heat waves, which often occur together and may affect disease pressure. Here, we explored a complex multi-stress framework by combining drought and heat stress with downy mildew infection in grapevine, determining their possible interactions (synergistic or antagonistic) on pathogenesis, and detailing their effects on grapevine leaf physiology.

pmc-13424186.title: Risk factors and clinical impact of bone pain in patients with multiple myeloma – A prospective interdisciplinary study
pmc-13424186.creator: Carlotta Pietsch, Monika Engelhardt, Julian P. Maier, Gabriele Ihorst, Hagen Schmal, Evangelos Terpos, Ioannis Ntanasis-Stathopoulos, Ralph Wäsch, Georg W. Herget
pmc-13424186.description: BackgroundBone pain affects up to 80% of patients with multiple myeloma (MM) patients and significantly impairs quality of life (QoL), yet its specific predictors remain poorly characterized. Identifying risk factors is essential for early intervention and personalized treatment.MethodsThis prospective, single-center study included 352 patients. Bone pain was recorded using a standardized questionnaire.

pmc-13559057.title: Oral Health Knowledge and Training of French Community Pharmacy Students
pmc-13559057.creator: Lise Gentet, Lucile Barré, Alexia Marie-Cousin, Sylvie Jeanne, Sarah Dion, Solen Novello
pmc-13559057.description: PurposeTo investigate the sixth-year community pharmacy French students’ perception of their oral health education and knowledge.Methods and MaterialsAn analytical cross-sectional study was conducted using a questionnaire sent by e-mail to sixth-year community pharmacy students of 20 faculties of pharmacy. Data were collected online, and descriptive data analyses were conducted.ResultsA total of 318 students responded to the survey.
